Filmmaker Bart Sibrel joins the Joe Rogan Experience for episode 2141 to make his case that the moon landings were faked. Sibrel has spent decades on the claim, confronting astronauts and building films around the footage he calls staged. Rogan gives the skeptic a full hearing.

Sibrel lays out his best points, from flag movement to radiation belts, and tells of his run-ins with the Apollo crew. Rogan tests the arguments and asks what proof would change Sibrel's mind. The episode preserves the moon-hoax case in its most committed form, useful for anyone who wants to hear it whole before judging it.
